exposure: history of ≥ 2 consecutive spontaneous abortions (SABs) at < 12 weeks
outcome: Small for gestational age birth weight
Neonatal complications (5-minute Apgar score < 5, perinatal death, and NICU admission)
cohort: 17,670 women with singleton and nonanomalous gestations at ≥ 20 weeks who delivered at an academic institution
finding: A history of ≥ 2 consecutive SABs was not associated with an increased incidence of PTB but may be associated with gestational diabetes in a subsequent pregnancy.
